findings.description: The same concept ("recent transactions") is rendered as "opérations récentes" in the counter but "Transactions récentes" in the section heading on the same page.

findings.expected: Parse the loan amount with fr-CA conventions (decimal comma, space as thousands separator) on the French form.
findings.description: On the French form, an amount typed with the French decimal comma (2500,50), which is within range, is rejected with the out-of-range message, while the equivalent 2500.50 is accepted in English. The parser only understands the English decimal point, and the error message misleads French users.
